reason: Provides an analyze_image tool that reads image paths, URLs, or pasted-image attachments and forwards them to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for visual questions and text extraction.

summaries.zh: 为文本模型提供图片分析能力，可读取本地或粘贴的图片并通过用户配置的兼容视觉端点回答问题。
summaries.en: Adds image analysis for text-only models by reading local or pasted images and querying a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint.

capabilities: Analyzes images through an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Reads local image files, HTTP(S) URLs, data URLs, and session attachments
Sends image content as base64 to the configured endpoint
Stores plugin settings and configuration presets in the host settings layer
Provides a WebUI configuration panel and connectivity test endpoint
